proposed_comments.title: Fail instead of silently skipping inaccessible directories

confidence.rationale: The exact upstream source suppresses inaccessible traversal errors, and an isolated ACL fixture reproduced false success upstream and fail-closed behavior with the literal replacement.

proposed_comments.body:
### Fail instead of silently skipping inaccessible directories

**Severity:** `medium`

`IgnoreInaccessible = true` makes the recursive scan omit directories it cannot read. If an omitted subtree contains a conflicting DLL version, the audit can report success based only on the readable portion; disable this suppression so the existing stop-on-error behavior fails an incomplete scan.

```suggestion
        var options = new EnumerationOptions { RecurseSubdirectories = true, IgnoreInaccessible = false };
```

proposed_comments.title: Return the discovery count for empty-input validation (2/2)

confidence.rationale: The literal second member is required with member 1; the complete atomic patch changes the exact-upstream excluded-only fixture from exit 1 to exit 0.

proposed_comments.body:
### Return the discovery count for empty-input validation (2/2)

**Severity:** `medium`

After exclusions are applied, `files.Count` is the audit subset size rather than the number of discovered manifests. Returning that filtered count makes an intentionally excluded-only target look empty and causes a false failure; return the saved discovery count instead.

```suggestion
        return new AuditResult { ScannedFilesCount = scannedFilesCount, Versions = all };
```

proposed_comments.title: Reject malformed top-level deps.json structures (1/4)

confidence.rationale: The exact-upstream malformed-root fixture exits 0; the literal grouped candidate exits nonzero with the structural error.

proposed_comments.body:
### Reject malformed top-level deps.json structures (1/4)

**Severity:** `medium`

A syntactically valid manifest with a missing or non-object `targets` property currently returns an empty result. Since the file still counts as discovered, the wrapper then reports a successful audit; throw a structural error rather than treating malformed input as an empty manifest.

```suggestion
                throw new InvalidDataException($"Invalid deps.json structure in {path}: expected an object with an object-valued 'targets' property.");
```

proposed_comments.title: Reject non-object target values (2/4)

confidence.rationale: A malformed non-object target fixture exits 0 on exact upstream and fails with the structural error on the literal candidate.

proposed_comments.body:
### Reject non-object target values (2/4)

**Severity:** `medium`

A target-framework entry with a non-object value is silently skipped, so part of a malformed manifest is omitted from the audit. Reject that shape rather than allowing remaining entries to produce a successful result.

```suggestion
                    throw new InvalidDataException($"Invalid deps.json structure in {path}: target '{target.Name}' must be an object.");
```
